**Subject:** [Security Training] Urgent Account Verification Notice

**Body:**
> This is a **training exercise** from your Security Team.  
>  
> You may occasionally receive messages that create urgency and ask for sensitive information such as passwords, Social Security numbers, or bank account details.  
>  
> **Do not ever reply with:**
> - Your full Social Security number
> - Your account number
> - Your online banking password
>  
> Red flags to watch for:
> - Urgent threats like “your account will be suspended”
> - Requests to reply with sensitive information
> - Links to unfamiliar websites
> - Poor sender addresses or suspicious formatting
>  
> If you receive a real message like this, report it to your security team or contact your bank directly using the number on your card or official website.
